metadata.source: User-produced screen-trace of PULSE's own rendered mouza boundary lines (lis.pulse.gop.pk), cross-referenced against the official Patwari (revenue) 42-mouza list for Tehsil Nishtar
metadata.supersedes: mouzas_nishtar_estimated.geojson (10 point-only estimates, removed -- all 10 now have full traced polygons here), and extends mouzas_nishtar.geojson (31 PULSE-API polygons, kept as the ground-truth cross-check reference) to the complete official 42-mouza set

status_categories.matched: 31 mouzas -- traced directly off a PULSE-rendered boundary line matching this Patwari name (or a resolved alternate PULSE spelling, see pulse_name)
status_categories.split estimated from official map: 4 mouzas (Dulu Kalan, Dulu Khurd, Gajjumatta, Kahna Kohna) -- PULSE renders these as part of one larger neighbouring polygon; split into the Patwari-named pieces using the Patwari sketch map as a guide
status_categories.matched + centre part estimated from off: 1 mouza (Kahna Nou) -- mostly a matched PULSE line, with a gap in the middle filled from the Patwari map
status_categories.matched - area less certain (gap in PULS: 1 mouza (Kot Pars Ram) -- PULSE's own rendered line has a gap here

validation.method: Independently reproduced by this project: (1) geometry validity check (all 42 valid, no self-intersections), (2) per-mouza IoU against the 31 real polygons already in mouzas_nishtar.geojson (PULSE ArcGIS 'Mouzas (Tentative)' layer) for every name that matches, (3) area-sum and union/coverage check against the authoritative tehsil_nishtar.geojson, (4) point-in-polygon check of this project's own independently-derived (sketch-georeferenced) estimated centroids for the 10 previously-unmapped mouzas.
validation.iou_vs_pulse_31: mean 0.921, median 0.956; 29 of 31 at or above 0.85 IoU. The two exceptions are both self-explained by this dataset's own status field: Dulu Khurd (IoU 0.277) is genuinely a split of a single larger PULSE polygon -- Dulu Khurd + Dulu Kalan's areas here sum to 12.21 km2 vs PULSE's single Dulu Khurd polygon at 12.41 km2 (1.7% apart); Kot Pars Ram (IoU 0.692) is flagged by the source itself as uncertain due to a gap in PULSE's own rendered line.
validation.area_sum_check: Sum of all 42 mouza areas = 235.49 km2 vs authoritative tehsil area 238.01 km2 (1.1% apart, expected given mouzas don't perfectly tile to the tehsil edge).
validation.coverage_check: Union of all 42 mouza polygons is 233.16 km2 with only 0.002% mutual overlap (clean tiling, no double-counting). 98.3% of the authoritative tehsil area is covered by at least one mouza; the union extends only 0.34% beyond the tehsil boundary (edge imprecision).
validation.estimated_centroid_agreement: All 10 of this project's own sketch-georeferenced point estimates (previously in mouzas_nishtar_estimated.geojson, now removed) fall inside the corresponding polygon here -- two independently-derived methods (affine sketch transform vs. PULSE screen-trace) agree on location for every previously-unmapped mouza.
validation.source_screenshots: 4 screenshots of PULSE's own rendered map (yellow boundary lines on a Google-style basemap) were provided alongside this data and visually confirm mouza names/boundaries not returned by this project's original ArcGIS attribute query, incl. Kamahan, Gajju Matah, Dulu Khurd, Dev Khurd Kalan, Bhallar, Kahna Nau, Kahna Purana -- consistent with this dataset's 11 gap-filling mouzas.

metadata.confidence: High for the 31 'matched' mouzas (mean 92% IoU against independent PULSE ground truth). Moderate for the 4 'split estimated' and 1 'centre part estimated' mouzas (internal split line is estimated, not traced from PULSE). This is the best available boundary data for all 42 Tehsil Nishtar mouzas pending real field GPS verification (see android-field-app/).
